concept.name: Wild Hair
concept.neutral: The subject has ordinary dark brown hair, casually brushed, lying close to the head.
concept.positive: The subject has wild dark brown hair: a huge lopsided fan of jagged spikes, springy corkscrew curls bursting between them, and fine flyaways shooting in every direction. One unruly lock curves partly over a cheek. The hair is gravity-defying, eccentric, and full of unruly volume.
